iti36:2.1: Nayidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati jana kuhanatthaṃ janalapanatthaṃ lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ iti maṃ jano jānātū-ti.
iti36:2.2: Atha kho idaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati abhiññatthañceva pariññatthañcā-ti.
